column1: # Impostor TN word list. Edit here, then run: dart run tool/build_catalog.dart
# One row per word. Columns (tab-separated): pack_id, label, word_id, word, variants.
# variants: other accepted spellings, separated by |. A guess must match a word or
# a variant exactly (only spaces are trimmed). Leave empty if there is none.
# Never reuse or change an id. New word: next free id in its pack.
# p01: words from the Product Owner. p02-p13: DRAFT proposals by Claude
# (2026-11-18), to be reviewed and corrected. All words and labels are in review.
